limitation: Grep heuristic on the single matched file per repo, not a full program analysis and no multi-file tracing of the binding mechanism; a false negative on binding (missing a real mitigation elsewhere in the repo) is more likely than a false positive on the pattern itself. The no-visible-binding count is therefore an upper bound, not a precise count. Individual repository names are deliberately not published here; re-run the accompanying script with the same query to reproduce your own per-repo breakdown.
